fields.Name: Structure
fields.Description: Root of the composition space: wrappers whose SLOTS accept other components, letting agents and users combine models into larger ones.
fields.Story: Structures are how components become bigger ideas: plug models into a wrapper and the ensemble inherits their stories.

fields.Name: Bagging Wrapper
fields.Description: Trains N bootstrap copies of whatever model fills base_estimator and averages them.
fields.Story: Take any single model you half-trust and turn it into a committee of itself.

fields.Name: Stacking Wrapper
fields.Description: Trains the models filling estimators, then a Linear final_estimator over their outputs.
fields.Story: Stacking lets different worldviews vote and learns how much to trust each voter — including reused, already-trained components.
